group.name: Select Installed Hideout Furniture Addons (Core HD Icons are installed automatically)

plugin.name: 349 - Hideout Furniture Expansion (Maid & HarukaSai)
plugin.description: Installs 2x HD icons (ui_maid_efp_props.dds, ui_rottenmeat.dds), scaled UI texture descriptors, and DLTX patches for all 33 items in Hideout Furniture Expansion by Maid & HarukaSai.

plugin.name: 385 - Even More Hideout Furnitures (facelessez)
plugin.description: Installs 2x HD icons (ui_decor.dds, ui_doors.dds), scaled UI texture descriptors, and DLTX patches for all 105 items (walls, doors, rugs, posters, cabinets, artifacts displays, and decor) in Even More Hideout Furnitures by facelessez.

plugin.name: 470 - Gadgets for Hideout Furniture (DoktorDauerfeuer)
plugin.description: Installs 2x HD icons (ui_gadgets_hf.dds) and DLTX patches for all 6 items (Alarm System, Rifle & Pistol Pegboards, Headgear Display, Artifact Harvester, and self-contained Trading Computer icon) in Gadgets for Hideout Furniture by DoktorDauerfeuer.

plugin.name: 473 - Hideout Cat for Hideout Furniture (DoktorDauerfeuer)
plugin.description: Installs 2x HD icons (ui_icon_hideout_cat.dds) and DLTX patches for both items (Hideout Cat and Hideout Cat Bed) in Hideout Cat for Hideout Furniture by DoktorDauerfeuer.
